subject: Medford Square Zoning Amendments
overview: The City Council and Community Development Board convened for a joint public hearing regarding proposed zoning changes for Medford Square. Due to persistent audio failures and technical difficulties with the hybrid meeting format, the bodies voted to continue the hearing to a later date.

items.title: Meeting Opening and Technical Issues
items.summary: The meeting experienced significant delays and audio feedback issues that hindered communication between in-person participants and those on Zoom.

items.title: Medford Square Zoning Amendments
items.summary: Continued the public hearing to March 3, 2026, because unmanageable technical difficulties prevented a full discussion on parking ratios, transit definitions, and the 2011 Medford Square parking study.
